method.implementation: Independent standard-library Python streaming parse of the original JSONL archives; no game or JavaScript analysis imports.
method.quantiles: Sort per-campaign max(finalRoster[].growth), using zero for an empty final roster, then apply R-7 linear interpolation.
method.late: floor >= 9; role counts and Asta proportions use present instances only; role growth maxima also include held but absent instances.
method.terminal: Use every recorded turn at actual run.floor, and count stars only when present; never substitute fixed floor12 or finalRoster stars.
method.population: Descriptive uniform mixture of the included policies; shared seeds are counted separately. These campaign quantiles have no CI and are not independent human samples.
method.growth: Retained additive growth value, not a damage multiplier. Normal, temporary and commission instances remain pooled because raw records omit status/UID.
method.assertionScope: The same 36 statistical assertions as the final read-only review. Source and main-coverage checks are recorded separately.
